description: This Java source file defines the DhlServices class which implements various DHL shipment related services, such as rate estimation, account registration, shipment confirmation, and request handling. It interacts with DHL's API via XML requests and processes XML responses to manage shipment operations within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: DhlConnectException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling DHL connection errors, extending GeneralException.

methods.name: sendDhlRequest
methods.description: Sends an XML request to DHL's server using configured URL and timeout, returns the XML response string.

methods.name: dhlRateEstimate
methods.description: Calculates a shipping rate estimate from DHL for a shipment, constructing request XML, calling DHL API, and parsing response to extract estimated cost.

methods.name: handleDhlRateResponse
methods.description: Processes DHL's rate response XML document, extracts error messages or shipping estimate details, and prepares the response map.

methods.name: dhlRegisterInquire
methods.description: Registers a DHL account / obtains a shipping key by sending a registration request XML and processing the response.

methods.name: handleDhlRegisterResponse
methods.description: Parses DHL register response XML to extract shipping key or errors.

methods.name: dhlShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Confirms a shipment with DHL, creates shipment request XML, handles the response, and stores tracking and label info.

methods.name: handleDhlShipmentConfirmResponse
methods.description: Parses shipment confirmation response XML from DHL, retrieves tracking number, label image, and updates shipment segment records.

methods.name: createAccessRequestDocument
methods.description: Constructs and returns an XML document for DHL access request based on configuration data.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Analyzes response XML elements for errors and populates the error list with descriptive messages.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for DHL shipment gateway from database or properties, based on shipmentGatewayConfigId and resource strings.
